<h2 id="一手搓线程池支持net10">一、手搓线程池支持.NET10</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>最近.NET10正式版发布</li>
<li>笔者每天打开VS2022和VSInstaller等推送升级</li>
<li>等到今天也没等到</li>
<li>就到微软官网查一下</li>
<li>原来是要安装vs2026</li>
<li>好吧装吧</li>
<li>可伶笔者的C盘再次报红了</li>
<li>手搓线程池项目也赶紧增加.NET10的支持</li>
<li>在.NET10下把单元测试都跑通过了,就赶紧发nuget包了</li>
<li>顺便做个项目演示一下手搓线程池打造抓不死的云应用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二环境准备">二、环境准备</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>开启Windows的Hyper-V组件</li>
<li>安装Docker Desktop</li>
<li>下载Jmeter(用于压力测试,解压即可用)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="三aspire快速开发云应用">三、Aspire快速开发云应用</h2>
<h3 id="1-微软天气预报经典案例">1. 微软天气预报经典案例</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>建一个WeatherApi的webapi项目</li>
<li>按年月日获取当天的天气</li>
<li>IWeatherService用来读取天气数据</li>
<li>为了更真实我们用MySql数据库来存储</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class WeatherForecastController(IWeatherService service, ILogger&lt;WeatherForecastController&gt; logger)
    : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IWeatherService _service = service;
    private readonly ILogger&lt;WeatherForecastController&gt; _logger = logger;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 查看天气
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [HttpGet("{year}/{month}/{day}")]
    public async Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; Get(int year, int month, int day, CancellationToken token = default)
    {
        WeatherForecast? weather;
        try
        {
            weather = await _service.GetWeather(year, month, day, token);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {

            _logger.LogError(ex, "An error occurred while getting weather for {Year}/{Month}/{Day}", year, month, day);
            return BadRequest(ex.Message);
        }
        _logger.LogInformation("Get /{Year}/{Month}/{Day}", year, month, day);
        if (weather is null)
            return NotFound();
        return Ok(weather);
    }
}
public interface IWeatherService
{
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 获取天气
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="date"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="token"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
    Task&lt;WeatherForecast?&gt; GetWeather(int year, int month, int day, CancellationToken token = default);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-用dapper实现iweatherservice">2. 用Dapper实现IWeatherService</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Dapper的CommandDefinition可以封装CancellationToken</li>
<li>CancellationToken对及时取消数据库超时有作用</li>
<li>特别注意这里我们用DbDataSource而不是DbConnection</li>
<li>DbConnection是会话级别的,依赖DbConnection的对象也必须是会话级别的</li>
<li>DbDataSource则做为单例完全没有问题</li>
<li>线程池必须是单例的,所以我们这里不能依赖DbConnection</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class WeatherService(DbDataSource dataSource)
    : IWeatherService
{
    private readonly DbDataSource _dataSource = dataSource;
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public async Task&lt;WeatherForecast?&gt; GetWeather(int year, int month, int day, CancellationToken token = default)
    {
        const string sql = """
                SELECT `Date`, `TemperatureC`, `Summary`
                FROM `weathers`
                WHERE `Date`=@date
                """;
        var date = new DateTime(year, month, day);
        var command = new CommandDefinition(sql, parameters: new { date }, cancellationToken: token);
        using var connection = await _dataSource.OpenConnectionAsync(token);
        return await connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync&lt;WeatherForecast&gt;(command);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-aspire管理应用和数据库">3. Aspire管理应用和数据库</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>nuget添加Aspire.Hosting.MySql</li>
<li>添加mysql及myWeather数据库</li>
<li>给myWeather数据库添加一个初始化sql脚本(myWeather.sql)</li>
<li>添加WeatherApi项目并引用myWeather数据库</li>
<li>WithReplicas给WeatherApi项目配置了两个副本,避免单点故障</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var dbName = "myWeather";
var mysql = builder.AddMySql("mysql")
    .WithEnvironment("MYSQL_DATABASE", dbName)
    .WithLifetime(ContainerLifetime.Persistent);

var initScriptPath = Path.Join(Path.GetDirectoryName(typeof(Program).Assembly.Location), "./Data/myWeather.sql");
var db = mysql.AddDatabase(dbName)
    .WithCreationScript(File.ReadAllText(initScriptPath));

builder.AddProject&lt;Projects.WeatherApi&gt;("weatherapi")
    .WithReference(db)
    .WaitFor(db)
    .WithReplicas(2);
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-sql">-- myWeather.sql
USE `myWeather`;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `weathers`
(
    `Date` Date NOT NULL,
    `Summary` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    `TemperatureC` int NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (`Date`)
);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-配置weatherapi项目">4. 配置WeatherApi项目</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>nuget引用Aspire.MySqlConnector</li>
<li>用AddMySqlDataSource注册mysql数据库非常简便</li>
<li>这么简单就完成了一个依赖mysql的云原生应用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
builder.AddServiceDefaults();
builder.AddMySqlDataSource("myWeather");
builder.Services.AddSingleton&lt;IWeatherService, WeatherService&gt;()
    .AddControllers();

var app = builder.Build();
app.MapDefaultEndpoints();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();
app.Run();
</code></pre>

<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>F5运行,直接打开Aspire的dashboard</li>
<li>包含1个mysql及数据库myWeather</li>
<li>WeatherApi启动了2个进程</li>
<li>《控制台》是用来查看日志的</li>
<li>《结构化》也是用来查看格式化后的日志</li>
<li>《跟踪》是APM的链路跟踪</li>
<li>《指标》是查看应用性能的</li>
<li>Aspire开发云原生应用虽然简单,功能却特别全</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

<h3 id="2-扩容到10个副本再测">2. 扩容到10个副本再测</h3>
<h4 id="21-扩容到10个副本">2.1 扩容到10个副本</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Aspire扩容实在是太方便了</li>
<li>把WithReplicas改成10就行</li>
<li>扩容后WeatherApi启动了10个进程</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/248830/202511/248830-20251116094951130-518201841.png" alt="dashboard" loading="lazy"></p>
<h4 id="32-再次jmeter-500并发测试">3.2 再次Jmeter 500并发测试</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过率是240,与2副本差别并不大</li>
<li>其他参数差别也不大</li>
<li>最小耗时和最大耗时区别巨大</li>
<li>应该是并发太高导致mysql处理不过来</li>
<li>有人可能说用redis缓存就行了</li>
<li>但如果每次请求的参数都不一样,缓存利用率低并发压力还是在数据库上</li>
<li>这就好比挤公交,大家互不相让,谁也上不去啊</li>
<li>好好地排队就行了</li>
<li>手搓线程池擅长用队列控制并发</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

<h2 id="五用手搓线程池控制并发">五、用手搓线程池控制并发</h2>
<h3 id="1-先对请求参数进行封装">1. 先对请求参数进行封装</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>封装参数以便在队列中排队</li>
<li>增加了一个expireTime字段,标记排队过期的请求</li>
<li>并提供了一个GetWeather方法以便手搓线程池调用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class WeatherWarpper(int year, int month, int day, DateTime expireTime, CancellationToken token)
    : TaskCallBack&lt;WeatherForecast?&gt;, ITaskJobResult&lt;WeatherForecast?&gt;
{
    #region 配置
    private readonly int _year = year;
    private readonly int _month = month;
    private readonly int _day = day;
    private readonly DateTime _expireTime = expireTime;
    private readonly CancellationToken _token = token;

    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public bool Status
        =&gt; !_token.IsCancellationRequested &amp;&amp; _expireTime &gt;= DateTime.Now;    
    #endregion
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 获取天气
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="service"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="token"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
    public async Task GetWeather(IWeatherService service, CancellationToken token)
    {
        if (token.IsCancellationRequested || _token.IsCancellationRequested || _expireTime &lt; DateTime.Now)
        {
            OnCancel();
            return;
        }
        var linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(_token, token);
        var weather = await service.GetWeather(_year, _month, _day, linked.Token);
        OnSuccess(weather);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-为天气服务定制处理器">2. 为天气服务定制处理器</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>增加了一个expireTime字段,标记排队过期的请求</li>
<li>实现IQueueProcessor接口以便手搓线程池调用</li>
<li>实现IWeatherService以便替代原天气服务</li>
<li>GetWeather方法负责打包参数并加入队列,并不实际执行</li>
<li>加入队列后,线程池自然会处理它</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public sealed class WeatherProcessor(IQueue&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt; queue, IWeatherService originalService, TimeSpan expireTime)
    : IQueueProcessor&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt;
    , IWeatherService
{
    #region 配置
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 队列
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    private readonly IQueue&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt; _queue = queue;
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 原始服务
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    private readonly IWeatherService _originalService = originalService;
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 过期时间
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    private readonly TimeSpan _expireTime = expireTime;
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 队列
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    public IQueue&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt; Queue
        =&gt; _queue;
    #endregion
    #region IWeatherService
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    public Task&lt;WeatherForecast?&gt; GetWeather(int year, int month, int day, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var result = new WeatherWarpper(year, month, day, DateTime.Now.Add(_expireTime), token);
        if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            Cancel(result);     
        }
        else
        {
            _queue.Enqueue(result);
        }
        return result.Task;
    }
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    Task&lt;WeatherForecast&gt; IWeatherService.CreateWeather(int year, int month, int day, CancellationToken token)
        =&gt; _originalService.CreateWeather(year, month, day, token);
    #endregion
    #region IQueueProcessor&lt;WeatherResult&gt;
    /// &lt;inheritdoc /&gt;
    async void IQueueProcessor&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt;.Run(IQueue&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt; queue, ThreadJobService&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt; service, CancellationToken token)
    {
        while (queue.TryDequeue(out var item))
        {
            if (service.Activate(item))
            {
                try
                {
                    await item.GetWeather(_originalService, token);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    Exception(item, ex);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                Cancel(item);
                break;
            }
            if (token.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;
        }
        // 线程用完释放(回收)
        service.Dispose();
    }
    #endregion
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 异常处理
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="callBack"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="ex"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;

    public static void Exception(IExceptionable callBack, Exception ex)
    {
        try
        {
            callBack.OnException(ex);
        }
        catch { }
    }
    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 取消
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    /// &lt;param name="cancelable"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
    public static void Cancel(ICancelable cancelable)
    {
        try
        {
            cancelable.OnCancel();
        }
        catch { }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-配置手搓线程池">3. 配置手搓线程池</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>与原配置就是多了RegistProcessor</li>
<li>为了与原始服务加以区分,服务键设置为SafeWeather</li>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel配置为32,2个副本也就是并发为64</li>
<li>ItemLife设置为3秒,这个设置比较宽松了</li>
<li>ItemLife不要设置太小,拦截的请求应该小于1%</li>
<li>expireTime设置为10秒,也是设置的比较宽松</li>
<li>expireTime也是不要设置太小,拦截的请求应该小于1%</li>
<li>拦截太多影响用户体验,只要避免手搓线程池被堵塞就行</li>
<li>现实项目可以多尝试几组参数,获取最优解</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

builder.AddServiceDefaults();

builder.AddMySqlDataSource("myWeather");

// Add services to the container.
const string weatherKey = "SafeWeather";
RegistProcessor(builder.Services, weatherKey, 32);
RegistServices(builder.Services);

var app = builder.Build();

app.MapDefaultEndpoints();

// Configure the HTTP request pipeline.

app.UseAuthorization();

app.MapControllers();
// 激活手搓线程池
_ = app.Services.GetRequiredKeyedService&lt;ReduceJobService&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt;&gt;(weatherKey);
app.Run();


static void RegistServices(IServiceCollection services)
{
    services.AddSingleton&lt;IWeatherService, WeatherService&gt;()
        .AddControllers();
}
/// &lt;summary&gt;
/// 注册线程池
/// &lt;/summary&gt;
/// &lt;param name="services"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
/// &lt;param name="name"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
/// &lt;param name="concurrency"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
/// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
static void RegistProcessor(IServiceCollection services, string name, uint concurrency)
{
    var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = concurrency, ItemLife = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3), ReduceTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(1L) };
    var queue = new ConcurrentQueueAdapter&lt;WeatherWarpper&gt;();
    services.AddKeyedSingleton(name, (sp, key) =&gt; new WeatherProcessor(queue, sp.GetRequiredService&lt;IWeatherService&gt;(), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)))
        .AddKeyedSingleton(name, (sp, key) =&gt; options.CreateJob(queue, sp.GetRequiredKeyedService&lt;WeatherProcessor&gt;(key)));
    services.AddKeyedSingleton&lt;IWeatherService&gt;(name, (sp, key) =&gt; sp.GetRequiredKeyedService&lt;WeatherProcessor&gt;(key));
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-controller几乎没区别">4. Controller几乎没区别</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>只是增加FromKeyedServices用来调用线程池处理器</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class SafeWeatherController([FromKeyedServices("SafeWeather")] IWeatherService service, ILogger&lt;WeatherForecastController&gt; logger)
    : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IWeatherService _service = service;
    private readonly ILogger&lt;WeatherForecastController&gt; _logger = logger;

    /// &lt;summary&gt;
    /// 查看天气
    /// &lt;/summary&gt;
    [HttpGet("{year}/{month}/{day}")]
    public async Task&lt;IActionResult&gt; Get(int year, int month, int day, CancellationToken token = default)
    {
        WeatherForecast? weather;
        try
        {
            weather = await _service.GetWeather(year, month, day, token);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {

            _logger.LogError(ex, "An error occurred while getting weather for {Year}/{Month}/{Day}", year, month, day);
            return BadRequest(ex.Message);
        }
        _logger.LogInformation("SafeWeather /{Year}/{Month}/{Day}", year, month, day);
        if (weather is null)
            return NotFound();
        return Ok(weather);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="5-压力测试">5. 压力测试</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>启动2个副本</li>
<li>500并发</li>
<li>通过率达到每秒2千多</li>
<li>没有错误</li>
<li>平均0.22秒</li>
<li>10%的请求0.28秒以上</li>
<li>5%的请求0.31秒以上</li>
<li>1%的请求0.45秒以上</li>
<li>手搓线程池是不是很神奇,把500并发限制为64个并发,发生了质的变化</li>
<li>原来的错误和超时都不见了,变得井然有序起来</li>
<li>这些高并发并不见得是数据库支撑不了</li>
<li>而是没有用正确的方式喂给它</li>
<li>一次喂太多把数据库给噎死了</li>
<li>手搓线程池可以作为一个智能的“喂食器”</li>
<li>如果数据量更大都超出了设计，即使忽略部分请求也不能打挂后端数据库是吧</li>
<li>大家觉得手搓线程池这个效果惊不惊喜、意不意外！！！</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

<h2 id="六-话说防抓取">六. 话说防抓取</h2>
<h3 id="1-取消超时请求">1. 取消超时请求</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>某些只读场景突发高并发</li>
<li>不拦截就会拖垮应用</li>
<li>是不得不拦截一部分请求</li>
<li>这时可以从前端传个请求时间过来</li>
<li>太高并发Web服务器也是要排队的</li>
<li>部分请求到Action响应时就可以考虑直接取消了</li>
<li>把前端请求时间叠加到超时时间参数里面</li>
<li>以便及时取消超时请求</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-中间件处理">2. 中间件处理</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrencyLimiter等并发控制中间件也是选项</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
